title: IMPACT: code for "Quantifying Biomedical Publishing and Citation Metrics"
description: IMPACT computes monthly rolling citation rates for every PubMed-indexed journal from public data (PubMed and the NIH Open Citation Collection). This archive holds the pipeline, the website and the analysis code in 10-31-26/scripts/ that builds every figure and Data S1 of the paper "Quantifying Biomedical Publishing and Citation Metrics". Live site: https://dantyrr.github.io/IMPACT
